proof_rows.title: Training, augmentation, stopping and checkpoint management
proof_rows.detail: 29 October request explicitly includes segmentation training. No job launched: exact source/label/preprocessing protocol, remote input versions and usable free Kaggle resources remain unverified. Authorization alone is not training proof.
proof_rows.required_proof: Exact source/version/split hashes, seed, finite budget, history, stopping reason and immutable checkpoint.
